Elena — thanks for the heads up and for attaching the confirmation. Two quick items from our side:

- Our collections team receives funds to a pooled account and uses the virtual-account reference to auto-apply incoming sweeps. The IBAN you listed is recognized, but the reference string "ACME_SWEEP_1012" does not map to any individual invoice in our posting rules.

- We need either (A) invoice numbers inside the remittance or (B) a bank trace (MT103/full payment trail) showing the transaction reference/beneficiary reference so our AR system can reconcile automatically. Without that we have to allocate manually, which may delay your credit booking and VAT tagging.

Could you confirm whether the EUR 112,560 covers both INV-2027-0891 (EUR 48,200) and INV-2027-0902 (EUR 63,840) net amounts? Also state whether VAT was withheld on your side (if so please confirm the VAT amount and the legal basis — e.g., local reverse-charge). If you can re-send a remittance that explicitly lists invoice numbers we can post the payment same day.

For transparency, cc'ing Laura (payments operations) and Marcus (tax/accounting) to expedite the trace and VAT treatment.

Best,
